arguments:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export GIT_PAGER=cat PAGER=cat GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT=0 PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1
tmp="$(mktemp -d /tmp/rea-plcodex-bwrap.XXXXXX)"
trap 'rm -rf "$tmp"' EXIT
git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch main https://github.com/martaxi-boss/Project-leader-codex.git "$tmp/repo"
cd "$tmp/repo"
test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 3ecdcd79573104c39ed644dbfd1bd57596e51d06
echo 'BWRAP_SOURCE_BEGIN'
sed -n '425,520p' codex/dual.py
echo 'BWRAP_TEST_REFERENCE_BEGIN'
grep -R -n -E 'trusted_bwrap|bwrap.*(owner|mode|uid|gid|writ|trusted)|serial.*sandbox|validator.*preflight' codex/tests | sed -n '1,75p'
echo 'BWRAP_RUNTIME_DIAGNOSTIC_BEGIN'
python3 - <<'PY'
import subprocess
from codex.dual import _trusted_bwrap
try:
 p=_trusted_bwrap()
 print("TRUST_GUARD=ACCEPT",str(p),flush=True)
except Exception as e:
 print("TRUST_GUARD=REJECT",type(e).__name__,str(e),flush=True)
args=["/usr/bin/bwrap","--die-with-parent","--unshare-all","--new-session","--ro-bind","/","/","--proc","/proc","--tmpfs","/tmp","--","/bin/true"]
try:
 p=subprocess.run(args,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=10)
 print("BWRAP_USERNS_PROBE_CODE",p.returncode,flush=True)
 print("BWRAP_USERNS_PROBE_ERROR",p.stderr[:500].replace("\n"," "),flush=True)
except Exception as e:
 print("BWRAP_USERNS_PROBE_EXCEPTION",type(e).__name__,str(e),flush=True)
PY
git diff --check
test -z "$(git status --porcelain)"
echo 'BWRAP_DIAGNOSTIC_FINISHED'
